label.zh: 愈合领域（原11:00-12:00）：双方每回合恢复10%体力
极限领域（原14:00-15:00）：双方每回合扣100体力
能量领域（原19:00-20:00）：双方伤害翻倍

capture.zh: 完成任务「奇妙的新生命」后，在比格星沃尔夫洞穴召唤并挑战劳克蒙德；每天三个时段各有一种领域；打败获得劳克蒙德精元（孵化得劳特）。

strategy_notes.zh: 先消强化再打；速度250以上就能先手；用超能、飞行、暗影/电系克制，魔焰猩猩、阿克希亚等秒杀型精灵速战速决，能量领域时段（双方伤害翻倍）最有利。

engine_notes: Three time-window fields become variants (no real-time clock): healing = both sides heal 10% max HP per turn; extreme = both lose 100 HP per turn; energy = both deal double damage. Every fight takes a variant, as each time window had its field; any variant clear pays the 精元.
alternating_immunity: on even turns it becomes immune to one damage class, cycling 特殊攻击无效 → 物理攻击无效 → 属性攻击无效 (techbang: 每个领域时段偶数回合会依照顺序出现…).
Innate boost (天然强化，最好是消强化再打) — stats not stated; atk+2, as unstated innate boosts are atk+2 (user decision 2026-10-19).
unlimited_pp and 100% accuracy per techbang. Very high crit damage noted; no number.

skills: no period source names the Boss's moves; the set is species 490's last four at or below Lv80, the original server's default for a Boss without its own list, inferred from the 20 fully documented SPT fights. A debut-day report that it boosted itself twice (7k7k 2010-10-15) fits 规则掌控, its only self-boost.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
source_note: 4399 BOSS page (2010-10-16): 5000血, 三领域, 需完成奇妙的新生命; techbang (2011-01): 时段, PP无限, 偶数回合轮流无效.
